scope: Complete creature, melee and aura rules in one persistent transaction per step after prototype removal. Core content without Official Packages. No connected-player capacity claim.
concurrency: Owned compilation and integration tests finished before measurement. Existing live Realm and unrelated processes remain running.
interpretation: Three warmups and twenty measured samples per size, with twelve paired steps per sample and alternating execution order. Percentiles pool measured steps. Both implementations use the same patched runtime. CPU excludes the CLI subscriber. Memory measurements do not imply a uniform native reduction.
